item.title: How cold, heavy snow creates challenges for EMS crews
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Emergency medical crews across the Ozarks prepare for winter storms every year, but it's often the bitter cold — not the snow itself — that creates the biggest challenges. "We have been through these winter storms before," said Bob Patterson, EMS director with Mercy. "Really, the challenge is the incredibly cold temperatures." [...]

item.title: Plumbing, HVAC calls on the rise as freezing temps remain
item.description: Lorenz Plumbing and other HVAC and Plumbing companies in the area have been responding to an increase in emergency calls due to the winter storm, with frozen pipes and HVAC units being the most common issues.

item.title: Record-breaking cold gives way, details when you can expect snow to melt
item.description: Springfield and surrounding areas have reached record lows, with a feels-like temperature of -23, but relief is on the way as winds shift and temperatures are expected to rise to near 40 degrees by Wednesday.

item.title: John Goodman to host concert for the Route 66 centennial celebration in Springfield
item.description: The National Route 66 Centennial Kickoff Celebration will be held in Springfield from April 30 to May 3, 2026, featuring talent such as John Goodman, Little Big Town, and more.
